en.headline: Hong Kong claim esports bronze in Honor of Kings at Asian Games
en.dek: The SAR team lost in the semifinals to Malaysia and share third place with the Philippines under the no-bronze-match format.
body: Hong Kong, China secured another esports bronze medal at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Monday after the Honor of Kings team reached the semifinals.

The side of Cheng Ka-hin, Kwok Ho-wa, Kong Tsz-kin, Li Ka-hing, Deng Xinzhan and Chui Sum-ki lost to Malaysia in the last four. With no third-place playoff, Hong Kong share bronze with the Philippines, who also exited in the other semifinal.
The team had earlier beaten Laos in the quarter-finals and finished top of their group after wins over Indonesia and Thailand. The result is Hong Kong’s second esports medal of the Games.

zh.headline: 亞運電競王者榮耀港隊摘銅
zh.dek: 港隊準決賽不敵馬來西亞，賽制不設銅牌戰，與菲律賓並列第三，為今屆第二面電競獎牌。
body: 香港、中國代表隊於愛知名古屋亞運電競《王者榮耀》項目準決賽不敵馬來西亞，鎖定一面銅牌。
港隊由鄭嘉軒、郭浩樺、江子健、李嘉慶、鄧幸展及徐琛淇組成，早前小組賽兩連勝及八強直落兩局擊敗老撾晉級。由於賽制不設銅牌戰，港隊與另一場準決賽落敗的菲律賓並列第三。
這是港隊今屆亞運第二面電競獎牌。馬來西亞將與中國爭奪金銀牌。
